description: This file provides utility functions to manage Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) sessions within a Playwright testing context. It includes functions to establish a CDP session for a given page and to run code within a page-scoped CDP client.

methods.name: async function withPlaywrightPageCdpSession<T>( withPlaywrightPageCdpSession
methods.description: Establishes a CDP session for a given Playwright page, executes a provided asynchronous function with the session, and ensures cleanup by detaching the session afterward.

methods.name: export async function withPageScopedCdpClient<T>(opts: { withPageScopedCdpClient
methods.description: Creates a page-scoped CDP client that executes a provided function with a method to send CDP commands, using the underlying session created by 'withPlaywrightPageCdpSession'.
